text: The new kind depends on merge-automation and declares single grouping for its dependency-derived task. It selects the Shipit worker, shipit-merged implementation and release-level-specific server scopes with the mark-as-merged action. Accepted code adds task-context processing later. These comm declarations describe task inputs and permissions; imported transforms and a successful Shipit action were not verified.
title: Mark-as-merged is a separate grouped dependency task
